phase: 2b (narrow first step toward DATAFLOW R3; the code comment calls it R3)
change: OriginalApplicationMatchBindings keeps each actor record's last session/model pair (ActorPairs: 400 slots per side, NSLock, shared by copies of the per-session memoized bindings). read returns the cached model form when the session record equals the cached stored side; store returns the cached stored form when the model record equals the cached model side, and leaves an allocation entry alone when it already equals the new one. Pairs are set only after a successful conversion.

review: independent read-only review: OK. Equal records imply equal conversions (objects and objectTokens are private lets set with the cache and are exact inverses), failed conversions never populate the cache, record and Allocation equality cover everything observable, a skipped assignment keeps the existing key and order. Notes: the DATAFLOW R3 label names a larger change (documented there); the cache can make gameplay's first write to a just-read actor copy its record; the 400 matches the init guard.
